direction: Hero cover: strong single focal subject, cinematic scale, room for title overlay.
Conceptual abstract cover: metaphors and shapes for ideas, not literal scenes.
Metaphor-driven cover: visual story symbolizing the article thesis.
Scene cover: environmental storytelling still, editorial photography or illustration.
Minimal cover: large empty title-safe region, restrained subject, quiet premium.
Typography-led composition: abstract letterforms/blocks as graphic (avoid long readable fake text).
